description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy at the rate for the Rice
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and modification of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that amends the application of an existing law (by waiving part of the levy), which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements. Although a named government official (the Minister of Finance) is issuing the order, the core content is about the legal/regulatory action itself, not about government personnel or structural changes. Therefore, the specialized Legal/Regulatory classification takes precedence over a government personnel classification.
